news.summary: Sebi is likely to release a consultation paper on foreign investor compliance requirements within weeks, chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey said. The regulator is also planning a capacity-building network to strengthen independent directors’ effectiveness.

news.headline: Sebi bars EKI Energy, MD Dabkara, others from market; imposes penalty
news.summary: Markets regulator Sebi has barred EKI Energy Services Ltd and its Managing Director Manish Kumar Dabkara from the securities market for two months and 12 months, respectively, for misrepresenting financial statements of the carbon credits trading firm and diverting funds. Also, the regulator has restrained the company's former Chief Financial Officer (CFO) Mohit Kumar Agarwal from the securities market for eight months, while whole-time directors Naveen Sharma and Sonali Sheikh have been prohibited for five months and one month, respectively. Besides, Sebi has imposed monetary penalties totalling Rs 88 lakh on the company and other individuals for various violations of securities market regulations. Further, the markets regulator directed Dabkara to take immediate steps to recoup the amount diverted from EKI Energy Services.
